description: CommonJS shim exposing the @noble/ed25519 surface that @selfxyz/agent-sdk uses (hashes, getPublicKey, signAsync, verifyAsync), implemented on node:crypto. Exists because @noble/ed25519 v3 is ESM-only and Vercel's function loader rejects require() of ES modules; the real package is used everywhere else.
name: @noble/ed25519
